d: Australia's Sandpaper Gate controversy refuses to go away. Eight years after the Cape Town ball-tampering scandal, Cameron Bancroft's latest claims have reignited the debate over who knew what, while Pat Cummins finds himself facing uncomfortable questions about his version of events. Yet the strongest support has come from Josh Hazlewood, whose comments offer a glimpse into the dressing-room bond and the respect Cummins commands as Australia's Test captain. Rupha Ramani looks at why this latest controversy is about much more than the events of 2018.
